infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Porter uses your location to set your pickup point and match you with nearby porters.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Porters share live location during an active delivery so senders can track their package in real time.

infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Porter lets you attach a photo of your package from your library.
